alt: 兩位學生各自拿著海洋與森林的布景模型，負責人卻攤開雙手含糊回應，讓兩人不知該採用哪個方案。
scene_prompt: 模稜兩可 means giving a vague noncommittal opinion that can be understood either way, not simply choosing between attractive options. Contemporary school art club: a young adult club leader stands between two students who present two mutually incompatible stage decoration proposals: one cardboard model has blue sea waves, the other has green forest trees. Both students look confused and wait for a clear answer. The leader wears an evasive half-smile and shrugs with BOTH palms upward, glancing between both models without pointing or choosing either. Arrange the undecided leader clearly in middle, students on either side, each holding their own supported model. An empty tabletop center waits for a decision. No written checkmarks, question marks, labels or dialogue. Hands naturally open with correct fingers, two arms per figure, no merging model and hands. Make evasive response and others' uncertainty unmistakable, not an instructor praising both completed projects.
